obligations.text:
Enterprise and New Towns (Scotland) Act 1990
19
The Enterprise and New Towns (Scotland) Act 1990 is amended as follows.
20
In section 2(4)(a)
(functions in relation to training for employment etc.) for “section 3(1) of the Race Relations Act 1976” substitute “
section 9 of the Equality Act 2010
”.
21
In section 16(2)
(courses of training etc.: duty to give preference to certain categories) for “Disability Discrimination Act 1995” substitute “
Equality Act 2010
”.
22
For section 17 (encouragement of women, members of minority racial groups and disabled persons to take advantage of opportunities for certain work etc) substitute—
Encouragement of women, members of ethnic minorities and disabled
